sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Pocket Gintoki Image Scramble are simplicity itself - move the blocks by touching or clicking on them to solve the puzzle.
               The game's objective is to reassemble a picture by sliding the tiles into place.
               Players can move the tiles up, down, left, or right, and the game will automatically check if the picture is complete.
               If the picture is complete, the player will be rewarded with a sense of accomplishment and satisfaction.

               One of the key features of Pocket Gintoki Image Scramble is its random tile generation.
               Each time the player starts a new game, the tiles will be rearranged, providing a unique and challenging experience.
               This feature ensures that the game remains fresh and exciting, even after multiple playthroughs.

               The game also features a variety of puzzle types, including classic, expert, and extreme modes.
